angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 50,925,240 km at 94.80 pc = 7.18 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19, Sect. 1: d = 94.8 +/- 5.0 pc, the Hipparcos parallax 10.55 +/- 0.56 mas (van Leeuwen 2007) the paper adopts (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202140478): 94.8 +/- 5 pc; Gaia DR3 cannot see the star
radiusSource: Radius 73.2 +/- 3.9 solar radii from Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19, Table 3 note and Sect. 5.3: R = 73.2 +/- 3.9 solar radii from the power-law limb-darkened PIONIER diameter 7.184 +/- 0.0017 +/- 0.029 mas and the Hipparcos distance (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202140478): 50,925,240 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 9.81 +/- 1.83 solar masses from Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19, Table 4: (M/Msun)_Ross = 9.81 +/- 1.83, from the SED fit's log g (1.70 +/- 0.05) and the radius (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202140478); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 7661 +/- 81 K from Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19, Sect. 5.3: Teff 7661 +/- 81 K from the bolometric flux of the SED fit and the PIONIER diameter (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202140478). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Domiciano de Souza et al. (2021), A&A 654, A19, Sect. 5.3: Teff 7661 +/- 81 K from the bolometric flux of the SED fit and the PIONIER diameter (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202140478)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/canopus.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 1.701, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: SIMBAD, * alf Car: spectral type A9II (1989ApJS...69..301G)
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, * alf Car: main object type *, Star
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, * alf Car: projected rotation speed 9 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's measured spectrum (Pulkovo spectrophotometric catalogue, table 5 (320-1080 nm, 2.5 nm steps, 10 nm resolution, absolute flux in W m^-2 m^-1)) (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
